contracts.source_fact: executestep suppresses physics when error is nonzero, but then always increments n and returns 0. outputext assigns a result only for error 0 or 1.
contracts.static_consequence: Callers cannot learn the timestep error from executestep's return value; an error outside {0,1} leaves outputext's function result unassigned on that path.
contracts.unresolved: The traced timestep routine sets only 0 or 1, but this does not prove every possible producer of saved error is restricted to those values across re-entry or future changes.

contracts.topic: BMI time-step getter has model and collective side effects
contracts.source_fact: get_time_step creates fresh local counters/reference values, calls compute_dt with par as intent(inout), then returns par%dt. compute_dt imports xmpi_module.
contracts.static_consequence: The getter recomputes and mutates par%dt and follows compute_dt's compute-rank/MPI behavior rather than being a pure scalar read.
contracts.unresolved: Host coupling code must establish whether every MPI rank calls this getter consistently; no host contract is present in this tree.

evidence.quote:
subroutine get_time_step(timestep) bind(C, name="get_time_step")
      !DEC$ ATTRIBUTES DLLEXPORT :: get_time_step

      real(c_double) :: timestep
      integer :: ilim = 0
      integer :: jlim = 0
      integer :: it = 0
      real*8 :: dtref = 0.d0

      call compute_dt(s,par, tpar, it, ilim, jlim, dtref)
      timestep = par%dt
   end subroutine get_time_step

subroutine compute_dt(s,par, tpar, it, ilim, jlim, dtref, dt, ierr, limtypeout)
      use params,         only: parameters
      use spaceparams
      use xmpi_module
      use logging_module
      use paramsconst

      IMPLICIT NONE

      type(spacepars), intent(inout)   :: s
      type(parameters), intent(inout)  :: par
      type(timepars), intent(inout)    :: tpar
      integer, intent(inout)           :: it
      integer, intent(out), optional   :: ierr,limtypeout
      real*8, intent(in), optional :: dt
      real*8, intent(inout) :: dtref
      integer, intent(inout) :: ilim, jlim
      integer                     :: i
      integer                     :: j,j1,j2
      integer                     :: n,limtype
      real*8                              :: mdx,mdy,tny
      real*8,save                         :: dtold
      real*8                              :: celeru

      if(.not. xcompute) return

if (dtref .eq. 0.0d0) then
         ! If dtref is not yet set.
         dtref = par%dt
#ifdef USEMPI
         ! Use the same dtref everywhere.
         call xmpi_allreduce(dtref,MPI_MIN)
#endif
      end if

      ! wwvv: In the mpi version par%dt will be calculated different
      ! on different processes. So, we take the minimum of all dt's
#ifdef USEMPI
      call xmpi_allreduce(par%dt,MPI_MIN)

contracts.topic: MPI lifecycle ownership and rank split
contracts.source_fact: The USEMPI implementation calls MPI_Init and MPI_Finalize directly. World rank 0 is xomaster/output-only; all other ranks compute; world rank 1 is xmpi_imaster and compute rank 0 is xmaster.
contracts.static_consequence: A USEMPI host cannot treat the library as neutral with respect to an already-owned MPI lifecycle, and at least two world ranks are required.
contracts.unresolved: No MPI_Initialized/MPI_Finalized interoperability branch is present in the traced routines.

evidence.quote:
subroutine xmpi_initialize
      ! initialize mpi environment
      implicit none
      integer ierr,color,errhandler,r,comm_world
      external comm_errhandler
      ierr = 0
      ! Message buffers in openmpi are not initialized so this call can give a vallgrind error
      ! http://www.open-mpi.org/community/lists/users/2009/06/9566.php
      ! http://valgrind.org/docs/manual/manual-core.html#manual-core.suppress
      call MPI_Init(ierr)

xmpi_ocomm = MPI_COMM_WORLD
      call MPI_Comm_rank(xmpi_ocomm,xmpi_orank,ierr)
      call MPI_Comm_size(xmpi_ocomm,xmpi_osize,ierr)
      if (xmpi_osize < 2) then
         print *,'Number of MPI processes must be 2 or greater, but is:',xmpi_osize
         call halt_program(.false.)
      endif
      xmpi_omaster = 0
      xomaster     = (xmpi_orank == xmpi_omaster)
      xcompute     = .not. xomaster
      !
      ! Create the compute communicator. This will contain all
      ! processes in xmpi_iocomm except process xmpi_master
      !
      color = 1
      if(xmpi_orank == xmpi_omaster) color = 0
      call MPI_Comm_split(xmpi_ocomm,color,1,xmpi_comm,ierr)
      call MPI_Comm_rank(xmpi_comm,xmpi_rank,ierr)
      call MPI_Comm_size(xmpi_comm,xmpi_size,ierr)
      call MPI_Comm_set_name(xmpi_comm,'xmpi_comm',ierr)
      call MPI_Comm_set_name(xmpi_ocomm,'xmpi_ocomm',ierr)
      xmpi_master = 0
      xmaster     = (xmpi_rank == xmpi_master)

subroutine xmpi_finalize
      ! ends mpi environment, collective subroutine
      implicit none
      integer ierr
      call MPI_Finalize(ierr)
   end subroutine xmpi_finalize

contracts.source_fact: execute_counter starts at zero and t01 is assigned only when execute_counter equals 1, before the counter increments. final always passes n and t01 to writelog_finalize in USEMPI, where t/n and duration/.../n are evaluated.
contracts.static_consequence: Finalizing with zero executed steps divides by zero in logging; under USEMPI, finalizing before the second executestep also supplies an unassigned t01 to the MPI loop-time expression.
contracts.unresolved: The standalone driver normally steps while t<tstop, but exported BMI/dynamic callers can choose a shorter lifecycle and no guard is visible here.

contracts.topic: Python wrapper cleanup does not invoke native finalization
contracts.source_fact: The Python constructor changes process cwd and remembers olddir. Its finalize method unloads the shared library and resets only shouldinitialize; it does not call self._lib.finalize() or restore olddir.
contracts.static_consequence: Using this wrapper's finalize bypasses core log/MPI finalization and leaves the process working directory changed.
contracts.unresolved: The wrapper may have been intended for serial experiments with process teardown, but that restriction is not encoded in the class.

cross_version_resolution.historical_document_fact: The 2008 parallelization report describes a master performing input/output and does not describe the current distinct output-only world rank.
cross_version_resolution.current_source_fact: At the checked source SHA, xmpi.F90 assigns world rank 0 to xomaster and world rank 1 to xmpi_imaster, while compute rank 0 is xmaster.
cross_version_resolution.adjudication: Treat the report as historical design context and the current source/build manifests as authoritative for this ledger. This is version drift, not evidence that both current topologies execute simultaneously.
